title: C3 conversational alert rule (canonical 9-field form)
description: Canonical 9-field alert rule from the paper: event, objects, area/zone, threshold, time_of_day, severity, cooldown_sec, side_effects, cadence_hz. The optional count object is a derived compatibility view for backend/app/routers/alerts.py AlertRuleSpec; it is not a tenth scored field. A rule returned with needs_clarification=true may be partial and is never inserted into MongoDB. The 120-utterance benchmark is author-constructed, not human-annotated.

objects.description: Detected-class subset O; each entry carries a class name.

threshold.description: Numeric threshold tau. Unit is persons/vehicles/objects for count thresholds and seconds for loiter duration. 'between' stores [low, high].

time_of_day.description: Daily time window T with cross-midnight support. An empty object means no time restriction (persistent rule).

severity.description: Implementation severity s; the paper maps {info, warning, high, critical} to {low, med, high}.

side_effects.description: Side-effect set Sigma. Default is snapshot + push_ws; store_clip is added when a clip is requested.

count.description: Derived compatibility field for AlertRuleSpec; not part of the 9-field score. A 'between' threshold is expanded to paired >= and <= operators, which alert_engine.matches_count_condition understands.

time.description: Optional AlertRuleSpec absolute-window compatibility field; the canonical 9-field representation uses time_of_day.

needs_clarification.description: Present on materializer output. True means the rule is partial and must not be inserted.

clarification_kind.description: Materializer classification: clean or one of the four stress kinds.
